data.one_liner: Inspect and generate Windows Metadata (.winmd) files based on ECMA-335.
data.what_it_does: Inspects and generates Windows Metadata (.winmd) files based on the ECMA-335 standard. It parses .winmd files into strongly-typed object models, queries type definitions, merges files, and programmatically generates new metadata.
use_when: You need to parse or generate Windows Metadata (.winmd) files in Dart
You are building Windows interop tooling or need to introspect WinRT types cross-platform
avoid_when: You are building standard cross-platform UI apps that do not deal with low-level Windows metadata
strengths: Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux) via direct binary parsing
Rich introspection of nested types, constants, parameters, and attributes
weaknesses: Low-level domain-specific tool, not needed for typical application development
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and import it.
